intent: What do the Sawgrass Country Club and Sawgrass Players Club sides actually publish about the architectural review process for a turf or putting-green project?
distinctValue: Both sides of Sawgrass publish their own review paperwork. The Country Club side's architectural review application (dated June 2024) spells out two checks with every submission — a nonrefundable review fee and a separate, partly-or-fully refundable construction deposit that penalties and fines come out of first — plus fixed outdoor work hours (Monday-Friday 7 a.m.-5 p.m., Saturday 7 a.m.-3 p.m., no work Sundays or the named federal holidays). The Players Club side runs through a master architectural review board with its own coordinator, over 16 subassociations that each keep their own board and governing documents. Neither source states which approval comes first.

sources.label: Sawgrass Association: architectural review application
supports: Fees: Two checks must be attached to the application made out to the Sawgrass Association. One is a nonrefundable processing fee and the second is a refundable in whole or part construction deposit that will be refunded upon inspection and approval by the Architectural Review Committee.

The property owner must send two separate checks with this application made payable to Sawgrass Association, Inc. One is for the nonrefundable review fee and the other is a refundable, in whole or part, construction deposit. Any penalties or citation fines will be deducted from the construction deposit.

Outdoor Hired Work Hours: Monday: Friday 7 AM to 5 PM Saturday: 7AM – 3 PM Sunday and Designated Holidays: NO WORK (New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas)

Outdoor Hired Work Hours Monday – Friday: 7:00am to 5:00pm Saturday: 7:00am to 3:00pm No Outdoor Work Permitted on Sunday & Designated Federal Holidays. (New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day.)

sources.label: Sawgrass Players Club: architectural review
supports: Marsh Landing Management Company, located at 4200 Marsh Landing Blvd., Suite 200, Jacksonville Beach, FL 32250, manages the Sawgrass Players Club master association and its Architectural Review Board (ARB) Coordinator.
The community contains 16 subassociations that each maintain their own Boards, governing documents and property management companies.
